worldcombat.skill.boomburst.summary: Holds its breath, then blasts the sound pressure out all around: foes around it (air and ground alike) are hit and flung away, harder and further the closer they stand; the bang leaves ringing ears on everyone hit, the caster included. Concussive is narrower and heavier with a longer fling.
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.use.0: Blast a whole ring of foes off you when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.use.1: Hurl close pursuers out of position
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.use.2: Sweep a full ring, treating air and ground alike
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.use.3: Trade one long wind-up for the heaviest hit
The pressure sphere bursts all around: at most %3$s enemies each take one blast, hardest at the centre — the %1$s damage at the core falls to about %2$s%% at the rim, and the fling weakens toward the edge too. Each target's special defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
It reaches %1$s blocks (air and ground alike); those hit are flung up to %2$s blocks outward and slightly upward, furthest near the centre.
The bang leaves %1$s s of ringing in everyone hit, the caster included; the ringing is just a mark of being caught in the blast and does not change movement or actions by itself.
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.concussive.o: Concussive on: about ×0.72 radius, ×1.3 blast and ×1.35 fling, wind-up +3 and cooldown +8 ticks, for blasting a ring further.
Concussive off (spread): about ×1.12 radius with a smaller blast and fling, casting faster, for sweeping more foes at once.
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s, the reach to %3$s blocks, and the fling to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.preference.c: On: about ×0.72 radius, ×1.3 blast and ×1.35 fling, wind-up +3 and cooldown +8 ticks, for blasting a ring further or cracking one tough target. Off (spread): about ×1.12 radius with a smaller blast and fling but faster casting, for sweeping more foes at once.
worldcombat.skill.boomburst.preference.a: The companion only considers Boomburst when a threat is this close; lower it to blast only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible foes must stand inside the blast before it fires; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to blast at a single target.
